$do_not_edit: Edit packages/contracts/src/tools/index.ts and rerun pnpm gen.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web for current information. Use whenever the user asks about news, events, prices, scores, weather, or anything time-sensitive — your training cutoff is months behind. Don't use it for general knowledge the user could just chat about.

query.description: The search query as a natural-language phrase.

count.description: How many results to retrieve (1-10). Default 5.

tools.name: render_artifact
tools.description: Show the user a visual artifact in the Atlas main window (map, chart, list, image, code, markdown, table, search_results, tutorial). Use it alongside your spoken reply — the screen carries detail your voice shouldn't. Don't read the artifact aloud, just acknowledge what's appearing.

type.description: Artifact kind. The frontend has a renderer per type.

data.description: Type-specific payload. The renderer decides the shape.

narration.description: Optional one-sentence label of what's appearing — falls back to the renderer's default if omitted.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Open a desktop application by its display name. Fuzzy-matches against installed apps. If the app is already running, focus it instead of launching a second instance.

name.description: App name as the user would say it (e.g., "chrome", "obsidian", "terminal").

tools.name: music_control
tools.description: Control music playback. Use 'play' with a query to start something specific via Spotify (if connected). Use 'play'/'pause'/'next'/'previous'/'volume' without a query for local MPRIS players.

query.description: Track/artist/playlist text — required only when action="play" and the user named something.

tools.name: open_path
tools.description: Open a file or folder with the system default app (xdg-open on Linux, `open` on macOS, `start` on Windows). Use for 'open my downloads folder', 'open the latest report', etc.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Search for files by name within an allowed scope (home/downloads/documents). Filename-only for V1; content search lands in Phase 7.

tools.name: system_action
tools.description: Adjust system settings (volume/brightness/DND/sleep). Use when the user asks 'turn it down', 'mute', 'do not disturb', 'lock the screen'. Always speak a one-sentence confirmation aloud BEFORE calling dnd_on or display_sleep — they're sticky.

value.description: Step size 0-100, optional. Defaults: volume ±5, brightness ±5.
